const parsed: any = JSON.parse('{"name":"x","size":3}');
function firstOr<T>(xs: T[], fallback: T): T {
  return xs[0] ?? fallback;
}
const first = firstOr(["a"], parsed.name);
console.log(first.length, first.anything);
const second = firstOr([parsed.size], 1);
console.log(second.toFixed(1), second.anything);
function pick<T>(a: T, b: T): T {
  return b;
}
const known: unknown = 1;
const picked: string = pick(known, parsed.name);
console.log(picked);
